source.title: Amended Guidelines on ICT and security risk management measures in the context of DORA application
source.applicability: Provides official supervisory guidance on ICT risk management governance and proportionality, clarifying requirements for management body accountability under DORA Articles 4, 5, and 16; narrows scope to DORA-covered entities

passages.text: The European Banking Authority (EBA) narrowed down the scope of its existing Guidelines on ICT and security risk management measures, due to the application of harmonised ICT risk management requirements under the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) from 17 January 2025.
DORA has introduced harmonised requirements on ICT risk management that apply to financial entities across the banking, securities/markets, insurance and pensions sectors.

originalText:
The EBA amends its Guidelines on ICT and security risk management measures in the context of DORA application | European Banking Authority
